result_driven_disclosure: The 5-position configuration was selected after observing the R237 stress matrix. This is NOT an independent discovery and must not be described as out-of-sample. This round freezes the 5-position candidate and its gates before running the R238 backtest, and only qualifies it for paper trading, not production.
hypothesis: R237 showed that R221's edge is highly concentrated: at 3x cost, 5 positions returned +53.34% versus +9.12% for 10 positions and -2.45% for 20 positions. The 5-position variant also survived 4x (+39.55%) and 5x (+26.80%) costs, while the 10-position baseline turned negative. This round tests whether the 5-position configuration preserves discovery-period performance, improves recent performance, and survives cost stress under a pre-specified gate set.

factor.definition: frozen from R221; TTM selling-plus-management expense ratio inverted, four consecutive quarters

execution.cost: 3x baseline: 6bp fees + 6bp commission + 15bp slippage + 10bp stamp tax; 4x and 5x scale all four components proportionally
execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022
execution.source_cache: R237 engine curves (r237_cache); cache hits are acceptable because the curves were produced by StrategyBacktestService in R237

gates.D1: factor coverage unchanged from R221 and at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m coverage at least 95%
gates.D3: candidate and control use the identical frozen factor, scoring weights and universe
gates.G1: candidate 3x full-sample total return is at least control + 10pp
gates.G2: candidate 3x full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 5pp
gates.G3: candidate 3x recent-12m total return is at least control + 10pp
gates.G4: candidate 3x rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: candidate 4x full-sample total return is positive
gates.G6: candidate 5x full-sample total return is positive
gates.G7: candidate 4x full-sample MDD is no worse than -45%
gates.G8: candidate discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control - 2pp
gates.G9: candidate validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control + 10pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. Passing qualifies the 5-position configuration for paper trading only, not production. The candidate is result-driven and must be labeled as such in every downstream report. No post-result tuning of positions, cost, weights, hold period or stop loss is allowed.
known_limitations: The 5-position configuration was selected after R237; this is not independent evidence.
A 5-position equal-weight portfolio is highly concentrated and has higher idiosyncratic risk than the 10-position baseline.
R237 rolling worst 1-year return for the 5-position variant is -26.78%, worse than the 10-position baseline's -21.21%.
The cost model is proportional scaling, not a full market-impact model.
Industry classification is a current snapshot, not historical PIT.
Passing gates would justify paper trading only.
